description: This source file defines extension methods for configuring Azure Cosmos DB clustering within the Orleans framework. It provides methods to add Cosmos clustering and gateway list provider configurations to various service builders and service collections.

classes.name: HostingExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for configuring Cosmos DB clustering and gateway list provider in Orleans hosting and services.

methods.name: UseCosmosClustering
methods.description: Configures Orleans silo builder or service collection to use Azure Cosmos DB for clustering. Supports various overloads for different configuration options.

methods.name: UseCosmosGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Configures Orleans client builder or service collection to use Azure Cosmos DB gateway list provider. Supports overloads for configuration.
